items.title: Identify all DONE-phase deterministic sync writes that can mutate final evidence bindings
items.context: Map the current DONE path for version bump, dist rebuild, package metadata, main sync, story DONE metadata, done-required evidence, review quorum, delivery check, and material hash binding. The target is only real CLI-owned mutations after final evidence, not broad optimization.
items.userSees: Agent can point to the concrete DONE ordering: pre-DONE readiness checks and user-triggered done_prepare happen before final DONE evidence consumption, while version bump, dist build, and experience cache refresh remain post-DONE merge effects.

happy.desc: Map the current DONE transition and recovery order so the exact deterministic writes before versus after final evidence checks are explicit.

edge.desc: Confirm post-DONE version bump, dist build, and experience cache refresh are not moved into pre-DONE readiness because they intentionally mutate runtime material state after DONE persistence.

adversarial.desc: Reject any broad lifecycle redesign that weakens evidence freshness, autoSyncMain safety, storyFilesHash binding, or material hash blocking semantics.

verificationEvidence.note: At commit 42929151 the DONE boundary is mapped: done_prepare performs pre-DONE validation recovery, while version package dist finalization remains outside pre-DONE readiness.
Decision docs continue to keep runtime version and finalization writes post-DONE and out of done_prepare.
Build and smoke preserve stale, wrong cwd, wrong branch, stale review, command-backed evidence, and version-bump rejection safety while adding DONE-required recovery.

items.title: Move deterministic DONE sync before final evidence binding or make the final evidence refresh bounded and automatic
items.context: Ensure final evidence is recorded after deterministic CLI sync has completed, or add a narrowly scoped one-pass refresh when stale is caused only by CLI-owned deterministic sync. Do not weaken material hash or storyFilesHash validation.
items.userSees: DONE readiness output routes ordering-sensitive blockers to one host-neutral recovery command: lattice done_prepare with mergeMain, refreshStale, and validate enabled, followed by the normal story_advance DONE path.

happy.desc: Evidence-freshness, DONE-required validation, and branch-synced-main blockers show done_prepare as the first recovery command.

edge.desc: DONE-required blocker preserves the original reason text while prefixing the ordered done_prepare recovery path.

adversarial.desc: Unrelated blockers such as missing test evidence or verification-intent coverage still point to validate or checklist repair and are not hidden behind done_prepare.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke proves evidence-freshness, DONE-required validation, branch-synced-main, and lifecycle_check recovery guidance converge on done_prepare.
done_prepare now invokes the existing done_required_validate path when policy is required and fails closed on failed DONE-required output.
Only ordering-sensitive DONE blockers route to done_prepare; ordinary test evidence and verification-intent coverage still route to validation.

items.title: Add regression coverage for DONE evidence freshness after internal sync
items.context: Create focused tests or smoke coverage that simulates or executes a DONE path with deterministic sync and proves final DONE evidence remains fresh without repeated manual stale refresh. Keep the test scoped to the observed correctness failure.
items.userSees: The regression smoke test demonstrates that a story branch behind main and missing DONE-required evidence receives done_prepare guidance, and that raw git merge main is not emitted as the primary recovery command.

happy.desc: A done-prepare smoke scenario asserts branch-synced-main and done-required-validation blockers route to the same done_prepare command.

edge.desc: The smoke scenario starts with missing DONE-required evidence and verifies the blocker remains visible instead of being silently waived.

adversarial.desc: The test asserts branch sync guidance does not regress to raw git merge main and does not imply evidence freshness predicates were bypassed.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke executes missing DONE-required evidence through done_prepare and proves PASS done-required evidence is written by the existing validator.
Smoke covers failing DONE-required validation and proves done_prepare blocks at validate while writing FAIL evidence for inspection.
Regression covers lifecycle_check mapping, avoids raw git merge main recovery guidance, and passes whitespace checks.

items.title: Update diagnostics or runbook text only where behavior changes
items.context: If the CLI gains a bounded auto-refresh or new DONE preflight step, update the user-facing hint or runbook text to describe the behavior. Do not add new host-specific or agent-specific workflow assumptions.
items.userSees: Any updated diagnostic or runbook text stays host-neutral and says done_prepare is the pre-DONE recovery assistant; it does not move version bump, package sync, or dist sync into pre-DONE evidence creation.

happy.desc: Documentation or diagnostic text, if changed, describes done_prepare as a host-neutral Lattice workflow command rather than a Codex- or Claude-specific step.

edge.desc: The docs continue to state or imply that version bump, package sync, dist build, and experience cache refresh are post-DONE effects, not pre-DONE validation material.

adversarial.desc: No stale guidance recommends manual raw git merge plus separate validate/refresh loops as the preferred DONE recovery path for this class of blocker.

verificationEvidence.note: Existing docs remain host-neutral and describe done_prepare as a Lattice lifecycle assistant, not a host-specific command.
Docs preserve the pre-DONE done_prepare versus post-DONE finalization boundary after the implementation change.
User-facing DONE recovery no longer relies on raw git merge plus separate stale refresh loops for the ordering-sensitive blockers.
